title: Outlive: The Science and Art of Longevity
author: Peter Attia
summary: Physician Peter Attia argues for shifting from treating disease to preventing it, and covers exercise, nutrition, sleep and emotional health as tools for living longer and staying capable in later life.
readIf: you want detailed, practical guidance on healthspan from a doctor's point of view.
skipIf: you want simple rules or a skeptical look at longevity claims.
